name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: Standard mutual NDA terms allowing two parties to exchange confidential information for purposes such as evaluating a potential business relationship.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement Cover Page
description: Signature cover page that incorporates the Mutual NDA Standard Terms by reference and captures deal-specific variables such as purpose, term, and governing law.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Standard terms for selling and buying cloud software/SaaS products, covering access and use, support, payment, term and termination, warranties, liability, indemnification, and confidentiality.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Agreement for giving an early customer access to a product in exchange for feedback and participation in a design partner program, prior to a full commercial agreement.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Standard terms defining uptime and support response time targets, service credit remedies, and termination rights for underperformance, designed to be used alongside the Cloud Service Agreement.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Standard terms for providing professional services under one or more statements of work, covering deliverables, intellectual property, payment, warranties, liability, and confidentiality.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Standard terms governing the processing of personal data between a controller/processor and processor/subprocessor, including international data transfer mechanisms (EEA SCCs and UK Addendum) and security incident response.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Standard terms for licensing on-premise or installed software, covering license grant, restrictions, updates, open source software, warranties, liability, and confidentiality.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Standard terms for a business partnership involving mutual obligations, optional fees, and a trademark/brand license between the parties.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Standard terms for a short-term trial or evaluation of a product before committing to a longer-term commercial agreement, with a more limited scope than a full commercial contract.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: Standard HIPAA business associate terms governing the use and disclosure of protected health information (PHI) between a covered entity/company and a business associate/provider.

name: AI Addendum
description: Standard addendum supplementing a product agreement with terms specific to AI/ML features, covering use of AI services, model training restrictions, ownership of inputs and outputs, and AI-specific disclaimers.
